steps.text: An empty office.
Gnosis is unused to the sight. He walks to his desk. Under his mug, filled with steaming-hot fresh coffee, is a document with Enciodes's signature.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: 'Letter of Appointment'.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Would it have killed you to come over and say goodbye...?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: ...It is signed.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You know how risky this is.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Minerals and land are inseparable. We shall bypass the Vine-Bead Court and sign cooperative mining agreements with foreign nations ourselves.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: This will cause a lot of headaches for us in the future.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If we do not pay them their pound of flesh now to close the gap, they shall simply demand much more from us later.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: This is the lowest price we are able to bear.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Your calculations are rather optimistic, Enciodes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And you have always been less optimistic than I am, no matter the topic.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Which means most times, you have been able to walk further than me.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: If it wasn't for that optimism of yours, I would not have the confidence to take a single step in the darkness.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It has been a long while since I heard such praise from you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Go, see our plans through, Gnosis.

steps.name: Karlan Trade Employee
steps.text: Everyone from middle management and above is here. We can start the camera at any time.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Begin recording.

steps.name: Karlan Trade Employee
steps.text: Yes, sir. What is today's announcement about?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I have gathered you all here today to announce a major change in personnel.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: As of today, Enciodes Silverash will no longer serve as Chairman and CEO of Karlan Trade.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Enciodes admits all responsibility for the recent occupational incidents and has resigned. The Board of Directors has already ratified his request.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: At the same time, the Board has decided that I, Gnosis Edelweiss, shall take over all of Enciodes's duties.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Now, allow me to make the first proclamation of Karlan Trade's new era as a representative of the Board, to all our colleagues, and to the people of Kjerag.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Karlan Trade shall be ceasing all collaboration with Victoria.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: As for the many past agreements that Enciodes insisted on signing, they shall all be temporarily paused until the Board has decided on further courses of action.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: At this extraordinary time, I ask all our colleagues to work hard at their posts, to keep the development of Kjerag at the forefront of their minds, and to sweep away the lingering problems of the past.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Kjerag needs us.

steps.name: Flippant Kjerag Guard
steps.text: Wake up, we're here for our shift.

steps.name: Impatient Kjerag Guard
steps.text: ...Sure took your time.

steps.name: Flippant Kjerag Guard
steps.text: First time we've been here, had to find the place.

steps.name: Flippant Kjerag Guard
steps.text: This lot been much trouble?

steps.name: Impatient Kjerag Guard
steps.text: Most of them aren't talking much. Just mind the lead geezer.

steps.name: Flippant Kjerag Guard
steps.text: Which one's he?

steps.name: Flippant Kjerag Guard
steps.text: Isn't the Vine-Bead Court all geezers?
Everyone bursts out in laughter before heading off, leaving just the two guards to take their shift.

steps.name: Cautious Kjerag Guard
steps.text: ...You should ease it up a bit. How could you disrespect the elders like that? You're from Kjerag too, right?

steps.name: Flippant Kjerag Guard
steps.text: Still sticking up for him? It was this bunch of Schiisdräck who got us into this mess—

spans.text: Still sticking up for him? It was this bunch of
who got us into this mess—

steps.name: Cautious Kjerag Guard
steps.text: Shut it, you got a death wish?
The two guards look towards Elder Adso as he sits within his cell. He is focused on the thick tome in his hands, playing with a corner of the page as he thinks.

steps.name: Cautious Kjerag Guard
steps.text: All's good.

steps.name: Flippant Kjerag Guard
steps.text: What're you so afraid of? They've been talking big for centuries now, but it's not like the Court's managed to flip Kjerag upside-down, have they?

steps.name: Cautious Kjerag Guard
steps.text: They're the vicars of Kjeragandr. Even if you don't respect the elders, you should still respect Her.

steps.name: Flippant Kjerag Guard
steps.text: What's the Court done that a guy like me needs to respect them?

steps.name: Flippant Kjerag Guard
steps.text: When my mom was sick, the clerics picked some grass for her to eat. Made me pray to the grass, saying that it would bring Kjeragandr's protection.

steps.name: Flippant Kjerag Guard
steps.text: In the end, we brought her to one of Karlan Trade's doctors. He told me, if we had kept going with the clerics' 'treatment plan', she wouldn't have lasted another day.

steps.name: Flippant Kjerag Guard
steps.text: I'd say the real vicar is Sir Enciodes!

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: ...'The scholar known as Jürgen was an ardent follower of Her, and did much good. Out of resentment, evil men accused him of stealing courtly coin, and he was to be put to death a few days hence.'

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: 'Jürgen's limbs were bound tight, and at night, he heard the clattering of soldiers' swords. He knew his death was near, and in his heart, he was anguished.'

steps.name: Cautious Kjerag Guard
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Flippant Kjerag Guard
steps.text: Guess I found which geezer to look out for.
The guard raises his baton as he approaches Adso's cell, striking the bars over and over. Adso does not stop his recitation as he looks at the guard calmly.

steps.name: Flippant Kjerag Guard
steps.text: Hey, greybeard, shut your mouth while you're in that cell.

steps.name: Flippant Kjerag Guard
steps.text: Think about how you're going to explain all your sins to Kjeragandr when you meet Her.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: 'Jürgen looked up but saw no light. In his futility, he knelt upon the straw lining his cell, in supplication to Her.'

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: 'O Righteous Kjeragandr, have I not done good in Your name? Have I not sought truth in Your name?'

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: 'Do good men die in Your kingdom while the unjust gain salvation?'

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: 'Why do the lawmakers only hear absurd falsities? Why do the people I saved stand in unspeaking silence?'

steps.name: Flippant Kjerag Guard
steps.text: Schiisdräck! Have you no shame, you traitor?!

spans.text: ! Have you no shame, you traitor?!

steps.name: Flippant Kjerag Guard
steps.text: I'm going to teach you a lesson—
The guard puts his baton away before taking out his key to open the cell door, though it keeps missing the keyhole as his right hand trembles in rage.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: ...'O Kjeragandr! Though my body be trapped in gaol, my soul still seeks Your mercy.'

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: 'Whilst my eyes can still see, and my ears can still hear, stretch out Your righteous hands to me!'

steps.name: Flippant Kjerag Guard
steps.text: I swear, today is going to be the last day you can even open a copy of the Kjeragandr!

spans.text: I swear, today is going to be the last day you can even open a copy of the

steps.name: Cautious Kjerag Guard
steps.text: Wh-What have I done...

steps.name: Cautious Kjerag Guard
steps.text: I hurt another guard...

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: You have done well, my child.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Our divine duty is not limited to the three clans, the Saintess, or the Vine-Bead Court.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: All children of Kjerag must be ready to carry out Her will at any time.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Just like you did.

steps.name: Cautious Kjerag Guard
steps.text: I remember... 'Jürgen the Confessor'.

steps.name: Cautious Kjerag Guard
steps.text: When I was young, I was lost in the snowy mountains. Just as I was about to black out, a cleric saved me.

steps.name: Cautious Kjerag Guard
steps.text: When we were on his burdenbeast, he took off his coat and wrapped it tight around me, telling me the story of Jürgen, and how Kjeragandr will save all the innocents...

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Where are the other clerics imprisoned, my child?

steps.name: Cautious Kjerag Guard
steps.text: Nearby.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Find an opportunity to free them. Let them escape, then save yourself.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Conflict brews atop the mountains. The Vine-Bead Court shall rebuild everything upon the ruins.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Allow me to tell you the end of the tale of Jürgen the Confessor.

steps.name: Kjerag Guard
steps.text: Halt!

steps.name: Kjerag Guard
steps.text: Don't force my hand, Great Elder. We are armed, and we will not allow anyone to leave!

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: ...I will walk by you.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: If you insist on using bows and crossbows to run counter to Her will, then aim at your own hearts. Try it.

steps.name: Kjerag Guard
steps.text: You...
The guards who rushed over look at their comrades with raised eyebrows as they form two lines. Many of them have chosen to stow their weapons, opening up a narrow passage.
Adso lowers his head as he walks through the guards, leaving behind faint footprints in the snow.

a.text: 'As the words left Jürgen's mouth, the entire gaol began to sway, as wind and snow entered through the cracks.'
'The walls around the imprisoned devotee were as rotten trees, shattering into dust as his body was enveloped in blinding light.'
'The soldiers were thrown to the ground, their weapons shattered, but they themselves were unharmed. They prostrated themselves at Jürgen's feet, weeping as they confessed their sins.'
'Jürgen the Confessor then walked the lands of the three clans, preaching this miracle the rest of his life.'
'And thus, Kjeragandr stretches out Her hand to those who call for Her, to enact Her justice.'

steps.text: She has slowly lost all sensation in her joints as her shoes sink into the soft snow, step after step after step, yet her legs do not stop moving, even as she gulps lungfuls of frigid air.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: Hah.... hah....

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: ...Who's... Hah...
There is the vague shape of people in the distance. They draw close to her, but the lights flashing before her eyes make her unable to recognize them.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Victorian Agent
steps.text: We have been ordered to receive you, Madam Carolin.

steps.name: Victorian Agent
steps.text: Though there should be others with you here.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: They got taken by the locals.

steps.name: Victorian Agent
steps.text: Then, are there any issues with the intelligence?

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: You can tell Her Grace that the power hiding behind Kjerag has disappeared.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: I've observed and recorded the fall of some extraterrestrial object to the surface. The ensuing Catastrophe is further proof of my conclusion.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: Whether it's the energy field theory or the Feranmut hypothesis, it explains the changes that happened to Kjerag.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: Take this folder, all my research into several hypotheses about Kjerag is in it. You can—

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: What the—?!

steps.name: Victorian Agent
steps.text: I am terribly sorry, Madam.

steps.name: Victorian Agent
steps.text: Did you really believe you could hide your personal communications with the Maylander Foundation from us?

steps.name: Victorian Agent
steps.text: Her Grace has asked us to bring back only the data.

steps.name: Victorian Agent
steps.text: I believe she is very interested in the fact that Kjerag has lost its protection.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: Extraterrestrial objects, Feranmut legends...

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: There are still so many marvelous things we don't know the truth about across this great land.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: But all you care about is deception, robbery and murder. Everything else is worthless to you.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: If I didn't need you to escape from Kjerag...

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: I would never work with people like you!

steps.name: Victorian Agent
steps.text: I shall pass on your complaint to Her Grace, verbatim.

steps.name: Victorian Agent
steps.text: Goodbye, Madam. Thank you for your patriotic 'service'.
She sighs deeply, unsure of whom she is actually feeling sorry for.

steps.name: Victorian Agent
steps.text: A smoke grenade?

steps.name: Victorian Agent
steps.text: Enemy attack! Look for cover!
The night is enveloped in smoke and gunfire, leaving the snowfield in utter chaos.
At least, until a black off-roader courses out of the smoke. In its wake are the Victorian agents, futilely shooting at the vehicle as it drives into the distance.

steps.name: Maylander Foundation Agent
steps.text: Sorry to put you through that, Carolin.

steps.name: Maylander Foundation Agent
steps.text: Had to take our time so the Victorians wouldn't spot us.

steps.name: Maylander Foundation Agent
steps.text: Got all your stuff?
She lowers her head, pulling out a marked file on the extraterrestrial object from the various documents before handing it to the agent sitting in the front seat.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: ...So, when can I start my research?

steps.name: Maylander Foundation Agent
steps.text: No need to be so hasty, Miss. My boss wants to have a chat with you first. He's really interested in hearing what you're studying.

steps.name: Maylander Foundation Agent
steps.text: I think you'll be working with us for a long, long time.
Carolin nods her head, before she suddenly realizes something.
She never had the chance to actually hand over Victoria's 'Kjerag report'.

She rolls down the car window, heedless of the cold wind blowing in. She takes out the papers she so painstakingly wrote in Kjerag, one after the other, and throws them out the window with nary a moment's hesitation.
The paper is all the more white under the black night, like fresh snow falling upon the wilds.
They spin through the air, buoyed by cold wind and political maelstrom both.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: Here's your things back, Victoria.
